subject.title: feat(ios): unify chat and voice experience

question: Should iOS permanently remove the standalone Talk destination and make Chat the sole conversational surface, with `talk` and `voice` launches routing to Chat?
rationale: The code can implement either direction, but current main deliberately provides a separate Talk tab and this PR changes established user navigation rather than correcting a defined regression.

options.title: Approve the Chat-first model
options.body: Accept Chat as the sole text-and-voice destination, retain the legacy launch aliases as Chat routes, and require rebase plus fresh upgrade/device proof before merge.

options.title: Keep a dedicated Talk destination
options.body: Retain Talk as a separate navigation surface and narrow the branch to shared ownership, capture, or Live Activity improvements that remain valid under that model.

options.title: Defer the navigation change
options.body: Pause this large feature until an iOS navigation decision or design specification defines the durable phone and iPad information architecture.

recommendation.title: Approve the Chat-first model
recommendation.body: Accept Chat as the sole text-and-voice destination, retain the legacy launch aliases as Chat routes, and require rebase plus fresh upgrade/device proof before merge.
